subject: ACME Health SOC 2 / Compliance follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Health SOC 2 / Compliance follow-up and next steps

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the procurement side: 

Key pain points you called out:
- Audit & evidence needs: SOC 2 Type II report, pen test artifacts for vendor risk review
- Access to audit logs with retention details (90+ days) for your Security & GRC team
- Data residency/segmentation and DPA controls for PHI-sensitive integrations
- Timeline: procurement needs final evidence and DPA signed within ~4 weeks to hit your Q4 rollout

What Redwood can offer (high level):
- We can share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and scoped pen test summary (redactions available)
- Exportable audit logs with configurable retention; default retention 90 days, options for 1yr+ on Dedicated/Private deployments
- Standard DPA we use with other health customers; we’re happy to review specific clause edits (data deletion, subprocessors)
- For on-prem or VPC customers we support customer-managed KMS and restricted network egress

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share the SOC 2 report, audit logs sample, DPA draft, and pen test summary (see attachments).
2) Your Security team to confirm whether the redacted pen test summary + SOC 2 report is sufficient for initial vendor review or if a completed questionnaire is required.
3) Schedule a short tech deep-dive next week (30m) with your SecOps to demo audit log exports + retention config. 

If that plan looks good, I’ll follow up with the artifacts and propose meeting times for next week (we’re PT/ET friendly).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (PDF, redacted sections), audit_logs_summary_2026.csv (CSV, sample), DPA_Draft_ACME_v1.pdf (PDF), pen_test_summary_2026.zip (ZIP, redacted)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health SOC 2 / Compliance follow-up and next steps

Thanks Marissa, really helpful recap. A couple clarifications from our side:

- For procurement, the vendor risk team generally accepts a redacted SOC 2 Type II + redacted pen test summary for initial approval. If they ask for more, we’ll come back with specifics.
- Audit logs: we need timestamped logs for authentication events, API access, and admin actions. Retention of 90 days is acceptable for now; please include fields that show hash/immutability markers if available.
- DPA: we’ll start with your standard DPA; our legal team will flag any sensitive changes.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether the audit_logs_summary CSV includes: event_id, timestamp (UTC), actor_email, action, resource, ip_address, and a hash/checksum column?

Also, Raj and I are available for a 30m tech deep-dive on Thurs 29 Oct between 9:00-12:00 PT or Fri 30 Oct in the afternoon.

Best,

Samantha Lee
Director, Security & GRC | ACME Health
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health SOC 2 / Compliance follow-up and next steps

Samantha,

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Short answers below and next items attached.

Audit logs: yes, the attached audit_logs_summary_2026.csv contains the columns you requested: event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_email, action, resource, ip_address, checksum_hash. The checksum column is a SHA-256 hash of the event payload; we include a separate verification utility for Dedicated customers.

Attachments included (attached to this thread):
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (redacted where necessary)
- audit_logs_summary_2026.csv (sample export with synthetic data)
- DPA_Draft_ACME_v1.pdf (standard template; track-changes accepted)
- pen_test_summary_2026.zip (high-level executive summary + remediation status)

Next steps I’ll take this morning:
- Share a short demo agenda and proposed time slots for Thurs 29 Oct 9:00-11:30 PT.
- Loop in our security SME to answer any technical questions on checksum/immutability and export format (cc: Neha).
- Provide a red-line-friendly DPA link and a suggested timeline for legal review (2 weeks recommended).

Neha / Vivek, I’ve cc’d you for visibility. Neha, can you confirm whether we should provide an HMAC-based log signature or the SHA-256 checksum is sufficient for ACME’s procurement? Vivek, if procurement requests an accelerated evidence package, can we queue Dedicated evidence access and expedited packaging?

Thanks,
Marissa

---
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf, audit_logs_summary_2026.csv, DPA_Draft_ACME_v1.pdf, pen_test_summary_2026.zip

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health SOC 2 / Compliance follow-up and next steps

Marissa / Samantha,

Confirmed for Thurs 29 Oct 9:30 PT for the tech deep-dive. Thanks for the artifacts, I skimmed the SOC 2 and pen test summary and that should be sufficient for our initial vendor review. A couple follow-ups for the call:
- Please have someone from your infra team show a live export of audit logs (even with redacted values) and demonstrate retention controls.
- We may ask for a short statement on your subprocessor list and deletion timelines (we can send specifics in advance).

Looking forward to the call.

Regards,
Raj Patel
Procurement Lead | ACME Health
raj.patel@acmehealth.com
